narrative.overview: VLSMatic is a calm technical instrument. Deep fields establish boundaries, cyan traces relationships and selection, and lime identifies capacity and safe forward actions.
keyCharacteristics: Cool-white working surfaces against deep navy infrastructure.
Real network quantities drive every visual indicator.
Semantic HTML remains complete before enhancement.

rules.name: Signal Ownership
rules.body: Cyan means relationship or selection; lime means capacity or forward action.

rules.name: Address Legibility
rules.body: CIDRs and exact address values use monospace or tabular numerals.

rules.name: Structural Depth
rules.body: Rows are separated with lines and tone; only major regions receive elevation.

dos: Do derive indicators from persisted server values.
Do pair color states with status text, labels, and focus treatment.
Do keep allocation data readable with JavaScript disabled.
Do disable nonessential movement under reduced-motion preferences.
Do use motion to reveal a real allocation boundary, connect selection states, or acknowledge an action.
donts: Don't introduce decorative charts, fabricated trends, or continuous animation.
Don't use lime as a generic decoration or cyan as the primary submit action.
Don't replace ledger rows with a wall of identical floating cards.
Don't make JavaScript the source of allocation truth.
Don't loop decorative motion or hide content before enhancement initializes.
